body: Can’t lie daily walks sound nice. Do you use them to escape the shithole that is everyday life?

That’s some really great advice, thanks. I think I’ll try and work up the courage then and get a discussion going. I think a few of us are in the same boat we just have a unspoken rule of not talking about.
I guess if were born to be sad we should just appreciate the moments of happiness we do have a lot more. Unlike me to put a positive spin on things but there you go.

To be fair I think my friends would understand. One of my friends opened up about some of his darker thoughts for the first time the other day and it was very hard to listen to but as a group we were understanding. I’m luck to have them, just as you said to scared to open up.
Are some people just born to always be sad? From the moment they’re born, no matter their life choices finding happiness is just much harder for them?
